candidates.summary: The event’s organizers would not say whether that included Israel, but its participation has been a matter of contention during the war in Gaza.

candidates.title: Lucy Davis, Star of ‘The Office’ U.K., Shares Terminal Cancer Diagnosis
candidates.summary: Lucy Davis, who portrayed the timid, frustrated Dawn Tinsley in the original version of “The Office,” said she had been diagnosed with Stage 4 breast cancer.

candidates.title: ‘The Wrong Girls’ Review: Dazed, Confused and Psychic
candidates.summary: Kristen Stewart and Alia Shawkat play telepathic best friends in this stoner comedy where a laboratory-engineered hallucinogen is on the loose.

candidates.title: South Africa’s Zeitz MOCAA Names Director to Replace Koyo Kouoh
candidates.summary: Elvira Dyangani Ose, who directed Barcelona’s contemporary art museum, will succeed Koyo Kouoh at Zeitz MOCAA after she died suddenly last year from cancer.

candidates.title: ‘Ted Lasso’ Season 4, Episode 2 Recap: Back to Richmond
candidates.summary: This week, Ted wakes up in England where he belongs and meets his new assistant coach.

candidates.title: A Puppet Festival That Asks, What if Judy Punched Back?
candidates.summary: The International Puppet Fringe Festival brings dozens of shows, films, exhibits and workshops to the Lower East Side. This year, the focus is on women.

candidates.title: ‘Mysterious Skin’: One of the Great Movies of the Early 2000s
candidates.summary: Gregg Araki’s coming-of-age drama, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt, tracks the story of two traumas with one source: a baseball coach.

candidates.title: ‘The Winter’s Tale’ Review: A Fable That’s Fit for Summer
candidates.summary: Shakespeare in the Park stages this melancholic comedy, which gives us a good excuse to spend time with Raúl Esparza and Lily Rabe as king and queen.

candidates.title: Joseph Havlat Stacks Up Variations on ‘Sinner, Don’t Let This Harvest Pass’
candidates.summary: Joseph Havlat’s thoughtfully programmed “Sinner, Don’t Let This Harvest Pass” spirals out from Schumann’s enigmatic “Ghost Variations.”

candidates.title: ‘Heated Rivalry’ Cried Out for Satire. Edinburgh Fringe Heard the Call.

candidates.title: Even With Space Cops and Magic Rings, ‘Lanterns’ Keeps It Real

candidates.title: In These Novels, Rich People Behave Badly. Very Badly.

candidates.title: Jimmy Fallon Recreates Trump’s Catering Container Escape

candidates.title: Judge Awards $250,000 to Musician Who Fled Trump-Led Kennedy Center Gig

candidates.title: Richard Lingeman, Cultural Historian and Biographer, Dies at 95

candidates.title: Spotify Will Label A.I. Artists and Avoid Promoting Them
candidates.summary: The new label, which will begin to be applied next month, is an effort by the streaming service to be more transparent about A.I.-generated music on its app.

candidates.title: Arlene Smith, Whose Song ‘Maybe’ Helped Define Doo-Wop, Dies at 84
candidates.summary: With the Chantels, a groundbreaking female vocal group, she tugged heartstrings with the indelible hit and paved the way for a wave of “girl groups.”
